"""The data ``AppFixtures`` seeds the database with."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, final, override

from xtr_orm_fixtures import Fixture

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

__all__ = ["AppFixtures"]


@final
class AppFixtures(Fixture):
    """Seeds the database; describe what it adds here."""

    @override
    async def load(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        """Add this fixture's objects to ``session``; the run commits them.

        ``session.add(book)`` adds one; ``self.add_reference("dune", book)``
        hands it to the fixtures that depend on this one.
        """
        del session  # Replace with the objects this fixture adds.
